newsitem.title: UK: Britannic new H1 regular premiums slip.
newsitem.headline: Britannic new H1 regular premiums slip.

text.p: Britannic Assurance Plc said on Wednesday that total new regular premiums in the first half of the year were six percent lower at 18.66 million stg while single premiums were slightly ahead at 65.89 million.

In May, a new field staff structure was put in place which resulted in the closure of more than 60 branches, bringing the number down to 133. It also involved setting up 380 teams with between four and six financial advisers each supervised and led by a sales manager.
"All this represented a significant amount of change and not surprisingly sales in April and May were depressed while changes were being implemented," Britannic said in a statement.
"However, it is most encouraging to report that the number of new ordinary branch proposals received in June was nearly 20 percent higher than during the equivalent period last year".
